metrics.operationalization: Estimated AI capex divided by AI revenue.
metrics.transformation: Percentile score; higher is more bubble-like.
metrics.note: Alternative specification to M2; do not score both.

metrics.operationalization: Quarterly capex growth less AI revenue growth.
metrics.transformation: Percentile score; higher is more bubble-like.

metrics.operationalization: AI infrastructure investment divided by US GDP.
metrics.transformation: Percentile score; higher is more bubble-like.

metrics.operationalization: Quarter-over-quarter AI revenue growth, tagged reported or estimated.
metrics.transformation: Direction selected after preregistered hypothesis; no reported and estimated values are pooled.

metrics.operationalization: Free cash flow divided by capital expenditure for public infrastructure providers.
metrics.transformation: Inverse percentile score; lower conversion is more bubble-like.

metrics.operationalization: Cost to reach a fixed, versioned capability threshold.
metrics.transformation: Quarterly log change and percentile score.

metrics.operationalization: Enterprise value divided by trailing revenue.
metrics.transformation: Percentile score; higher is more bubble-like.

metrics.operationalization: Growth rate required for a specified discounted cash flow model to support observed EV.
metrics.transformation: Percentile score; higher is more bubble-like; discount rate and terminal multiple are versioned assumptions.

metrics.operationalization: Documented AI-related debt issuance in the quarter.
metrics.transformation: Percentile score; higher is more bubble-like.

metrics.operationalization: Share of surveyed organizations reporting AI use, with survey universe retained.
metrics.transformation: Reported separately and sensitivity-tested for survey changes.

metrics.operationalization: METR task completion time horizon at 50% and 80% success.
metrics.transformation: Log change using actual observations; labeled software/ML/cyber task horizon.

metrics.operationalization: Growth in a fixed, versioned benchmark basket.
metrics.transformation: Composite log change; benchmark membership is frozen per release.

metrics.operationalization: Observed internal ecosystem financing and revenue flows divided by observed financing.
metrics.transformation: Descriptive only until transaction coverage is validated.

metrics.operationalization: AI research output divided by research labor and compute proxies.
